character_evidence.method: Ranked sources (producer texts, then The Good Scents Company, then Arctander/P&F, then supplier pages). Descriptors mapped to the 13 engine dimensions, position-weighted, scored 10*(1-exp(-0.6*raw)) per source family (producer 1.0, TGSC 1.0, literature 0.8, supplier 0.5), combined with the peak held at the mean of the family peaks. Checked against the engine's own hand profiles: 2.0 points mean held-out error versus 4.1 for no data. Design value, not a sensory measurement (RULE 1).

note_evidence.method: TGSC substantivity at 100%: 12 h or less top, 200 h or less heart, else base. Engine vapour pressure: 10 Pa or more top, 0.1 Pa or more heart, else base. Vapour pressure decides when they disagree. A producer's own note statement overrides both (stated in note_basis).
